newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sudanese nominated to head UN copyright agency.
newsitem.headline: Sudanese nominated to head UN copyright agency.

text.p: The U.N. agency for intellectual property and copyrights said on Thursday it nominated a deputy director for its top job which becomes vacant in September.

The World Intellectual Property Organisation (WIPO) said in a statement it nominated Sudanese deputy director-general Kamil Idris for the post to replace Arpad Bogsch, a Hungarian-born U.S. national who retires this year.
Idris will almost certainly be appointed WIPO director general by the agency's general assembly when it meets in September, its officials said.
A former journalist who worked for Sudanese newspapers in the 1970s, Idris served as legal adviser to Sudan's mission to the United Nations in Geneva before he joined WIPO in 1982.
Chosen from among ten candidates, he has been the deputy director general of WIPO since 1994.
